title: 🚧 Highway 50 Construction Through Tyndall Starts April 6 - NewsBreak
text:
8 hours ago Starting April 6, 2026 , crews will begin a major construction project on S.D. Highway 50 and Highway 37 through Tyndall . The $10.9 million project will rebuild and realign the highway, turning the current four-lane divided section into a five-lane undivided road with a shared turn lane. Work also includes new culverts, lighting, curb and gutter, and asphalt resurfacing.
Traffic will be reduced to two-way travel on one side of the highway at a time, and an 11-foot width restriction will be in place for the duration of the project. Drivers should plan for delays.
The project is expected to finish by November 20, 2026 . For major traffic updates, text TYNDALL50 to 605-566-4041 to subscribe to free alerts.
